narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms resulted in widespread flash flooding in the Berkshires on July 18. Numerous roadways were closed in Lenox, Richmond, Lee, Otis, Becket, and Pittsfield.
ev: A road construction project on Edgewood Drive over a creek was washed out due to flooding. A portion of East Street was also closed.
A section of Swamp Road was reported flooded and impassable.
North Street was closed between Burke Avenue and New Road in Pittsfield due to flooding.
There were numerous roads flooded in the town of Lenox. All available firefighters were called in by the Lenox Fire Department.
There was a report of flowing water moving across Housatonic Street.
There was report of flowing water and debris from a nearby stream moving across Walker Street.
Law enforcement reported Werden Road flooded near an egg farm.
Law enforcement reported Leonhart Road in Becket flooded.
West Center Road was flooded with some rocks and debris left behind.
